title: Cat6 cabling or Wi-Fi for a small office?
description: When a small Dubai office should use Cat6 network cabling, when Wi-Fi is enough, and why most offices need both.
body: Wi-Fi is convenient, but it is not the right answer for everything. For a small office in Dubai, the best setup is usually cable where it matters and Wi-Fi everywhere else.
What should be on a cable

Desktop computers, printers, the CCTV recorder, IP cameras, IP phones and the Wi-Fi access points themselves. These devices do not move, and a cable gives them a steady connection that is not affected by walls, neighbours or busy channels.
Laptops, phones and tablets that move around the office. With access points cabled back to the network rack, Wi-Fi coverage is even and fast.
Cat6 handles gigabit speeds comfortably and is the usual choice for new office cabling. For long runs or future upgrades, Cat6A or fibre between floors can be worth it.
Running cables during a fit-out or a quiet weekend is far easier than adding them later. Mizan can visit, count the points you need and agree the price before starting.
